topic_kernel.failure_to_detect: attributing every plateau to plasticity loss

competency.practice_task: Produce a preregistered test protocol and evidence record grounded in a dormant-unit and gradient-flow monitor.
competency.setting_constraint: Meet a declared latency and fail-safe limit under concurrent load.
required_evidence: a preregistered test protocol and evidence record
Include p95 latency, timeout behavior and rollback trace.
Report active-unit fraction across task switches with uncertainty or an explicit deterministic check.
Construct a negative control for the failure mode: attributing every plateau to plasticity loss.

assessment.scoring: Each criterion: 0 absent, 1 partial, 2 demonstrated; require 2 on all four.
assessment.threshold_policy: Register the metric threshold, baseline, task budget and evaluator before exposing new items.
criteria: Concept: correctly state the assumptions and limits of plasticity diagnostics.
Practice: a held-out challenge supports or rejects the claim.
Measurement: report active-unit fraction across task switches against a matched baseline with reproducible inputs.
Critical check: test for attributing every plateau to plasticity loss; detect it or rule it out with evidence.

competency.source_policy: Reviewer must add a verified primary source before lesson status; no source is fabricated here.
competency.contamination_policy: No private items, answers, seeds or reviewer-only prompts in this public specification.
